data.title: Arsan Agrees to Sell Armadaş Natural Gas Distribution Stake
data.description:
An announcement from Arsan Holding A.S. ( (TR:ARSAN) ) is now available.

Arsan Holding A.S. is identified as a shareholder in Armadaş Arsan Maraş Doğalgaz Dağıtım A.Ş., whose field of activity is natural gas distribution.

On November 26, 2026, Arsan signed an agreement to sell its entire 39.096% stake to Koni Teknik Mühendislik A.Ş., a wholly owned subsidiary of Aksa Doğalgaz Dağıtım A.Ş. The transaction is subject to legal permits, approvals and other agreed conditions; if completed, Arsan’s participation relationship will end and its ownership will fall to zero, while the price and any resulting profit will be determined at closing.

data.title: Rottenstone Gold Proposes Great Bear Royalty Acquisition
data.description:
An update from 79 Resources Ltd ( (TSE:SK) ) is now available.

Rottenstone Gold is proposing to acquire a 0.75% net smelter return royalty over certain Great Bear Project lease areas and associated exploration claims, some situated in Ontario and operated by Kinross Gold through Great Bear Resources. Subject to disinterested shareholder and CSE approval, the company would issue 18,064,516 shares at $0.155 each as non-cash consideration valued at $2,800,000.

The supplemental disclosure, issued at the request of Ontario Securities Commission staff, addresses details of the proposed related-party transaction and MI 61-101 requirements. An independent valuation dated August 7, 2026 placed the royalty’s fair market value at $2,400,000 to $2,800,000, while shareholders are scheduled to vote on December 7, 2026.

data.title: Klabater Adopts Share Issue Linked to Defence.Hub Gaming-Business Contribution
data.description:
An announcement from Klabater S.A. ( (PL:DFH) ) is now available.

Defence.Hub S.A. is a Warsaw-based issuer, while Klabater P.S.A. is its wholly owned Warsaw-based subsidiary. The transaction concerns the issuer’s organised GAMING segment, comprising tangible and intangible assets intended for gaming activities.

On 26 November 2026, Klabater’s Extraordinary General Meeting resolved to issue 300,000 new ordinary Series B shares at PLN 1.00 each, offered entirely to Defence.Hub. Defence.Hub agreed to subscribe for all the shares and undertook to transfer the segment as a non-cash contribution; the issue and articles amendment will become effective upon registration, and the issuer said the information could significantly affect its results and financial position.

data.title: CMX Starts Geophysical Program at Clayton Silver Project
data.description:
CMX Gold & Silver ( (TSE:CXC) ) has provided an announcement.

CMX has started its inaugural exploration program at the Clayton Silver Project, using 3DIP and magnetotelluric surveys across its patented and unpatented claims. The 1,028-acre property includes the historic Clayton mine, which produced approximately 7 million ounces of silver alongside lead, zinc, copper and minor gold during operations from 1935 to 1986.

The release describes the surveys as targeting known and new vein structures, extensions of partially mined ore bodies and deeper mineralization. On July 9, 2026, CMX closed a $910,000 first tranche of its non-brokered private placement, with units consisting of one share and one share purchase warrant.

data.title: Brazil Current Account Improves, But Misses Forecast
data.description:
Brazil’s current-account deficit narrowed to -3.9700 from -5.5700 previously, an improvement of 1.6000, or 28.7% in deficit magnitude. The result was therefore higher, meaning a smaller external shortfall than in the prior reading.

The deficit was 0.8700 wider than the analyst estimate of -3.1000, a 28.1% larger shortfall by magnitude. The miss may pressure sentiment toward Brazilian stocks, especially companies exposed to foreign exchange and external trade, while the improved trend versus the previous month offers some support; the effect is likely short-term unless it changes policy expectations.

data.title: SolidWorld Approves Merger by Absorption of Three Wholly Owned Companies
data.description:
Solid World Group S.p.A. ( (IT:S3D) ) has provided an announcement.

SolidWorld Group S.p.A., listed on EGM-Euronext Growth Milan under ticker S3D, is an Italian technology group integrating advanced 3D digital solutions and Artificial Intelligence for industrial, biomedical and defense applications. Its offerings include proprietary software and hardware for manufacturing and Electrospider, a 3D bioprinter for human tissues and organs.

The company said its board and the shareholders of wholly owned Solidcam Italia, Miralis and Solidinnovation in liquidation approved their absorption into SolidWorld Group through a simplified merger procedure. After the merger deed and required registrations, SolidWorld will assume the companies’ assets, liabilities, rights, obligations and existing relationships; accounting and tax effects will apply from January 1, 2027, while legal effects begin with the final required registration.

data.title: Bank Kasikorn Indonesia Announces PMHMETD IV Rights Offering
data.description:
PT Bank Kasikorn Indonesia Tbk ( (ID:BMAS) ) has issued an announcement.

PT Bank Kasikorn Indonesia Tbk is conducting its fourth limited public offering with preemptive rights, or PMHMETD IV, issuing 2,874,315,845 new shares at Rp350 each. The shares represent 13.70% of issued and fully paid-up capital after completion, with stated total proceeds of Rp1.006 trillion.

The HMETD and pre-listing of shares resulting from their exercise begin on November 27, 2026, while HMETD trading ends on December 3. Major shareholder KVF has declared it will exercise its rights and purchase any shares remaining after allocation, while shareholders who do not exercise their rights may experience ownership dilution of up to 13.70%.

data.title: NetraMark Reports Record Fiscal 2026 Contract Bookings, First CRO Engagement
data.description:
The latest update is out from NetraMark Holdings ( (TSE:AIAI) ).

NetraMark Holdings is an artificial intelligence company transforming clinical trials with AI-powered precision analytics in the pharmaceutical industry. For fiscal 2026, the company reported approximately C$3.415 million in new contract bookings involving Phase 2 and Phase 3 clinical-trial datasets, a 645% increase from its previous annual high of C$458,000.

NetraMark completed its Toronto Stock Exchange listing in February 2026 and raised C$3.5 million in gross proceeds through an insider-led financing, with insiders accounting for 65% of the offering. In December 2025, it also participated in a U.S. Food and Drug Administration meeting concerning machine learning for predictive clinical-trial enrichment.

The company worked with its primary contract research organization to incorporate NetraAI into sponsor bids and proposals, with the technology included in nine opportunities and one resulting in its first signed CRO-channel commercial contract in July 2026. Peer-reviewed publications and research collaborations involving NetraAI added to the evidence available to sponsors evaluating its clinical-development applications.
